title: error-code provenance: the Hono doors and the runtime dispatcher stamp `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` as a literal inside a ternary that `check:error-code-provenance` cannot see, and the ledger has no row for either package
body:
Filing gate **①**, a follow-up owed by landed work (PR #23682 and PR #23700, both this seat's). `reach:` **named real producers**: the two stamp sites below. Each one's wire answer was measured at a public door by its own PR (`POST /api/v1/data/:object` on both Hono doors; `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` on the dispatcher).

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `os-bill` · session `session_01FLwgbTSmGMrqsXkBDsiwfG`, from #23701's `os-dev-report` `6199848483` (out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## Governing text

- **`ERROR_CODE_LEDGER`** (`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`): "a code emitted by several packages is listed once per emitting package". `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` is listed under `@objectstack/types`, `driver-memory` and `driver-sql` only.
- **`check:error-code-provenance`** (`packages/spec/scripts/check-error-code-provenance.ts`): every stamp site of a registered code in `packages/**` non-test source must be listed under the stamping package's own owner key, or carry a recorded `PROVENANCE_WAIVERS` entry. Its own bounds line (`:326`) says it is "blind to helper/shorthand/ternary indirections".

## The two sites, on `origin/main`

- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts:362`: `isEngineDuplicateRecordEnvelope(thrown) ? 'UNIQUE_VIOLATION' : resolved.code` (PR #23682, #23587).
- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:1235`: `engineDuplicate ? 'UNIQUE_VIOLATION' : thrown.code` (PR #23700, #23686). The same file's `duplicateArmContext` compares against the literal at `:406`, which is a read and not a stamp.
- Both sit inside a ternary, so the gate stays green. The same gate went RED on PR #23713's (#23701) first spelling, a module constant in `@objectstack/mcp`. That PR now reads the code off `structuredCodeAnswer`'s arm (`@objectstack/types`), so `@objectstack/mcp` spells no copy of the code.

## Reader who acts

Triage grades it and routes it. Two remedies, both small. The second is the one PR #23713 already took, so the family would read one way:
- **`domain:spec`:** two ledger rows, `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` and `@objectstack/runtime` under `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`.
- **`domain:cli`:** re-spell both sites to relay the shared arm's code, as `@objectstack/mcp` does (`wireCodeOf` in PR #23713). Then neither package stamps the code and no ledger row is owed. No `packages/spec` edit.

Either way, pin it so the site's wire answer is unchanged (`UNIQUE_VIOLATION`). The gate's ternary blind spot is declared, not a defect of its own.

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `error-code-provenance ternary stamp blind spot UNIQUE_VIOLATION ledger row runtime plugin-hono-server` gave 38 hits, top 8 read.
- The nearest are #22664 (closed; `@objectstack/mcp` stamping `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` through a constant outside the gate's patterns) and #13353 (closed; five packages stamping without a row, swept). Both are the same class, for other codes and packages.
- None names these two sites.
